title: Apply the Pilobolus app-shell stack and confirm its compute role
description:
State as of 2026-10-19 16:40Z. The Pilobolus app-shell stack has not been applied; it applies in the Pilobol.us Amplify build (PR 96 merged, app d1eiwl0gedkmnj). The Prospectus registry has papyrus-pilobol-us with role amplify-app-shell-pilobol-AmplifyComputeRoleD988057-cBnMtgLxcwD1.

Next step: after the build, confirm on the Mac with read-only AWS: aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us-cms --query "StackResources[?ResourceType=='AWS::IAM::Role'].[LogicalResourceId,PhysicalResourceId]" --output text. If the physical id differs, update the Prospectus registry with the new ARN.
Blocker: needs AWS access (papyrus-production 712236451410), which only the Mac has. Cloud threads have none.
